# Gateway error codes

Thistlebay troubleshooting, reviewed 2026-06-11.

Every error the gateway returns carries a code. The table lists the codes edge
nodes emit together with the action this guide prescribes for the calling
client.

| code | meaning | prescribed client action |
| --- | --- | --- |
| TB-4001 | request body over the 8 MB edge limit | split the payload, then retry after 5 seconds |
| TB-4021 | upstream handshake timeout | wait 45 seconds, then retry once |
| TB-5030 | upstream connection pool exhausted | wait 120 seconds, then retry with a smaller batch |
| TB-5112 | gateway drained for maintenance | poll the status page, do not retry this request |

Codes are written to the request log next to the failing request id, so a
sync that fails on many requests can be grouped by code.

turns.prompt: Our nightly sync against the Thistlebay gateway keeps ending with error TB-4021. How many seconds does the gateway troubleshooting page ask the client to wait before trying the request again? Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
